settings.label: Server URLs (priority order)
settings.help: Enter one to five HTTP/HTTPS base URLs for the SAME server, separated by commas. First address has highest priority; HTTP, ports and subpaths are supported.

settings.label: Password
settings.help: MyGo displays and stores settings as plain text. Use a dedicated, low-privilege account.

settings.label: Authentication mode
settings.help: Leave empty or enter token (recommended). Enter legacy only if your server requires it. No automatic downgrade.

settings.label: Music folder ID
settings.help: Optional. Limits browsing, search and favorites where the Subsonic API supports it. Playlists are account-wide.

settings.label: Scrobbling
settings.help: Enter true to submit played tracks; empty or false disables it. This is a text setting, not a switch.
